content: Clarification and Preference Elicitation: Asking clarifying questions has been recently recognized as a necessary component in a conversational system BIBREF3, BIBREF7. The authors are not aware of a published solution for generating clarifying questions using public resources. Therefore, Macaw does not currently support clarification.
